subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should Clownfish adopt repository-scoped warmed fork leases, and should the first supported implementation depend directly on Crabbox/Mitos or use a runtime-neutral provisioning interface?
rationale: The requested optimization changes Clownfish's execution backend, credential boundary, cache trust model, and operational lifecycle; source evidence can confirm the gap but cannot choose those permanent product contracts.

options.title: Add an opt-in interface
options.body: Define a narrow fork-lease abstraction, initially support one approved backend, and preserve ordinary checkout provisioning as the compatibility fallback.

options.title: Integrate Crabbox directly
options.body: Use Crabbox's warmed-lease model as the first-class implementation and accept a tighter dependency between the projects.

options.title: Keep runner-per-job provisioning
options.body: Continue improving caches and concurrency without adding snapshot lifecycle or backend complexity.

recommendation.title: Add an opt-in interface
recommendation.body: Define a narrow fork-lease abstraction, initially support one approved backend, and preserve ordinary checkout provisioning as the compatibility fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest merged-history trail across the worker checkout and concurrency infrastructure affected by the decision.
